name: smwgraphics-k-on-yui-hirasawa
title: K-On! - Yui Hirasawa
description:
Submitted during Winter C3 2025!

It's Yui Hirasawa from the hit anime K-On!, now in Super Mario World style! Includes all of the poses included in the game, even the ending sprites! Pair it with her sister Ui (Available separately!) so she can tag along during adventures! Are you ready to start a jam session with her? You'll see why...

Credit goes to Eggroll27 for making the graphics (You can check out the spritesheet here!) and ported by yours truly for ROM hacking usage.

UDPATE (9/2/2025): Now with updated Player 2 palette to coincide with the release of Ui Hirasawa player graphics set! Also changed the shared palettes file extension from .pal to .smwpal to prevent confusion with YY-CHR palette files. (LM 3.50 and above)
